title: Design: Deactivate part confirmation looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part for this test, part A.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 3.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Type Superseded by a newer part in the Note (Optional) box.
  6. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive radio is filled blue.

Step 4:

  • A smaller white dialog opens over the Edit Inventory Part window, which dims behind it.
  • Its title "Deactivate part?" is large and bold, with a thin line under the title row.
  • The first line reads part A's part number, a space, then part A's description.
  • Then, in this order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are." (a little bolder), "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." (grey).
  • A white Cancel with a grey outline and a red "Deactivate" button sit at the bottom right.

Step 5:

  • The Note (Optional) box turns blue, its label moves up small and blue, and the box shows "Superseded by a newer part".

Step 6:

  • The confirmation closes and Edit Inventory Part shows again with Inactive still picked and the green "Active" pill.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R6: “For a deactivation from the part dialog, the confirmation states, in this order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are.", and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."”
  • S10-R9: “The "Existing records that use ..." line is medium weight. The "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." line is grey. Every other line is regular weight in the default text color.”
  • S10-R10: “The confirmation has a note field labelled "Note (Optional)". It stops accepting input at 255 characters.”
  • S10-R11: “The confirm button reads "Deactivate" in red for a deactivation and "Activate" in blue for a reactivation. Cancel sits to its left.”
  • S13-R23: “Cancelling the confirmation saves nothing and returns to the dialog with the picked status kept.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "3.3 Save asks first". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

The design also draws a grey close X at the right end of this confirmation's title row. Product confirmed on 27 Oct 2026 (answer 19) that the X stays and does what Cancel does (PRD v35, Key Decisions and S10-R11a); it is checked by the design case "Design: Status confirmation has a close X in its title row", so this case does not check it.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • retire-03-p3-3-confirm.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save raises "Deactivate part?" (S10-R1, S10-R3). It opens with the part number and description (S10-R4), then the three lines of S10-R6, then the optional note (S10-R10). The note here reads "Superseded by N6801-06-04X". The red Deactivate button has Cancel to its left (S10-R11). The bulk confirmation (board 4.4) is the same dialog, built from the design system Modal and Button.”
